title: Generation of Human Neutrophils from Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells Using ETV2 Modified mRNA
author: Majumder, Suknuntha, et al.

steps.title: Prepare flow cytometry buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 488 mL 1× DPBS, 10 mL FBS, 0.25 g sodium azide (NaN₃), and 2 mL 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0); filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm membrane, aliquot 10 mL per tube, and store at 4 °C (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Pre‑warm media and coat plate
steps.instruction: Retrieve a collagen IV‑coated 6‑well plate from 4 °C storage, let it equilibrate at 37 °C for ≥30 min; aspirate the collagen solution and add 2 mL pre‑warmed TeSR‑E8 complete media containing 10 µM Y‑27632 dihydrochloride to each well.

steps.title: Generate single‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: When hiPSCs reach ~60 % confluency (≈3 days), aspirate media and add 1 mL pre‑warmed HyQTase (or Accutase® as a substitute) per well; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 3 min (do not exceed 3 min). Add 1 mL pre‑warmed TeSR‑E8 complete media, collect cells into a 15 mL conical tube, centrifuge 350 × g for 5 min at room temperature, aspirate supernatant (do not aspirate HyQTase solution from the plate). Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL TeSR‑E8, centrifuge again 350 × g for 5 min, aspirate, then resuspend in 1 mL TeSR‑E8. Determine viability with trypan blue and a hemocytometer, and plate 2 × 10⁵ viable cells into each well of a fresh 6‑well plate containing 2 mL TeSR‑E8 with 10 µM Rock inhibitor; gently rock side‑to‑side to spread cells evenly. Incubate 30 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow adhesion.

steps.title: Prepare transfection reagents
steps.instruction: Place TransIT®‑mRNA reagent, mRNA boost (TransIT‑mRNA Kit, Mirus), and the ETV2 mmRNA aliquot on ice. In a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, prepare the ETV2 mmRNA transfection master mix (exact component volumes as per kit instructions); mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Transfect hiPSCs with ETV2 mmRNA
steps.instruction: Add ~100 µL of the transfection master mix drop‑by‑drop to each well of the 6‑well plate, distributing evenly; rock the plate after addition to ensure uniform coverage. Return the plate to a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator for 24 h. (Note: avoid using iPSC lines beyond passage 30, as hematopoietic differentiation capacity declines.)

steps.title: Stain cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in flow cytometry buffer (use polystyrene round‑bottom Falcon tubes). Add conjugated primary antibody to a final concentration of 0.1–10 µg/mL (prepare dilutions in buffer); optionally add Ghost dye™ Violet 540 for dead‑cell exclusion. Incubate ≥30 min in the dark at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash and acquire data
steps.instruction: Centrifuge stained cells at 350 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL flow cytometry buffer. Analyze the sample on a flow cytometer.
